about_the_game:
29 heart pumping tracks from the score for Darkenstein 3D.

Composer and Musician Bios

Rowye (Roger Creus Dorico):

Rowye is a lifelong musician who has been creating music since the early 90s, playing drums in bands ranging from dark folk (Neblia) to metal-jazz ensembles (Coure). For Darkenstein 3D, he channeled his love for classic 90s metal to create a massive, four-hour soundtrack that serves as the brutal, retro heartbeat of the game. Every level has its own music, as the soundtrack is an integral part of his vision.

Logan Mayhew:

Logan Mayhew is a guitarist and composer who brought his signature heavy riffs to several key tracks on the Darkenstein 3D soundtrack. He spends his time writing and recording for various Abstrakted Records projects, including The Design Abstract, Ethereal Void, and Loremaster.

Jake "The Voice" Parr:

Jake 'The Voice' Parr began composing ambient tracks in 2023, inspired by artists like Nine Inch Nails and Aphex Twin, as well as video game soundtracks like Quake and DOOM's PlayStation port. Jake creates unnerving and uncomfortable dark ambient tracks inspired by his struggles with mental health, alongside dream-like songs for sleep and/or dissociation. Some of his music has appeared in games like Darkenstein 3D and Berserker's Domain.
